description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultEntityId class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.id package. It tests immutability, equality and hashcode, null and empty input handling, instance retrieval, and dummy entity ID identification.

classes.name: DefaultEntityIdTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultEntityId, verifying immutability, equality, null and empty input handling, and entity ID properties.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultEntityId instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromNull
methods.description: Ensures that providing null to DefaultEntityId.of throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromEmptyString
methods.description: Ensures that providing an empty string to DefaultEntityId.of throws IllegalArgumentException with appropriate message.

methods.name: getInstanceFromDefaultEntityIdReturnsSame
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving an entity ID from an existing DefaultEntityId returns the same instance.

methods.name: dummyEntityIdIsDummy
methods.description: Tests that the dummy DefaultEntityId is recognized as dummy.
